newsitem.title: USA: Princeton Dental sells dental studio.
newsitem.headline: Princeton Dental sells dental studio.

text.p: Princeton Dental Management Corp on Monday said it sold its Mason Dental Southeast Inc/Renaissance Dental Studio to Lawrence Ceraulo.
The studio was sold for $92,096 in a short-term note, an additional $9,847 in a short-term note for supplies, and assumption of an existing note payable of $18,372, Princeton said.

Mason Dental Southeast Inc/Renaissance Dental Studio, had 1996 revenues of about $390,000, or some 2.2 percent of Princeton's total revenue. It operated at a loss to the company in 1996, Princeton said.
Princeton said the sale represented a profit of about $49,000 for the company.
Ceraulo does business as Certex Dental Studio, the company said. The sale took effect on June 1. ((--Chicago newsdesk, 312-408-8787))
